title: General Practitioner
description: Medics Online is recruiting a General Practitioner for a busy Johannesburg clinic. Responsibilities include outpatient consultations, diagnosis and treatment of common conditions, referrals to specialists, and chronic disease management. HPCSA registration required.

title: Cardiologist
description: A private cardiology practice in Cape Town seeks an experienced Cardiologist to manage a growing patient base. Must be comfortable performing echocardiograms and assisting with catheterization procedures. FCP(SA) Cardio or equivalent required.

title: Pediatrician
description: Growing pediatric practice looking for a caring, detail-oriented Pediatrician to join our Durban team, covering newborn checks, routine child health assessments, and vaccination programs.

title: Orthopedic Surgeon
description: A leading Pretoria hospital group requires an Orthopedic Surgeon experienced in joint replacement and trauma surgery. Theatre availability and on-call rotation required.

title: Anesthesiologist
description: Multi-disciplinary Johannesburg hospital seeks an Anesthesiologist for theatre lists across general surgery, orthopedics, and obstetrics. Must be registered with the HPCSA.

title: Registered Nurse - ICU
description: Busy Johannesburg ICU unit seeks a Registered Nurse with critical care experience. Must be comfortable with ventilator management and high-acuity patients. SANC registration required.

title: Registered Nurse - Pediatric Ward
description: Children's ward in a Durban hospital requires a compassionate Pediatric Registered Nurse. Experience working with infants and children preferred.

title: Theatre Nurse (Scrub Nurse)
description: Private Pretoria hospital theatre requires an experienced Scrub Nurse to assist in orthopedic and general surgery cases. Sterile technique and instrument knowledge essential.

title: Midwife
description: Cape Town maternity unit is hiring a qualified Midwife to support labour, delivery, and postnatal care. SANC midwifery registration required.

title: Nurse Practitioner - Primary Care
description: Community clinic network seeks a Nurse Practitioner able to run independent primary care consultations, manage chronic conditions, and perform minor procedures.
